source.title: National Performance Monitoring and Evaluation Manual

indicators.name: Ministries that produce an Annual Progress Report on the implementation of their strategic plan
indicators.measurement: Percentage of all ministries

indicators.name: Ministries that held at least two performance reviews during year
indicators.measurement: Percentage of all ministries

indicators.name: Production time of Annual Progress Report on implementation of National Development Plan
indicators.measurement: Measured in months
indicators.note: Do not apply an actual/target achievement ratio to elapsed time. A direction-specific rating protocol must be approved.

indicators.name: NDP performance indicators reported by Thematic Area in national Annual Progress Report
indicators.measurement: Percentage of indicators that can be reported

indicators.name: Evaluations undertaken on time
indicators.measurement: Measured against evaluations included in National Evaluation Plan, including NDP Mid- and End-Term Reviews
indicators.note: The table gives a percentage target but does not state a complete numerator/denominator formula; confirm the operational protocol.

indicators.name: Evaluations with management response to evaluation recommendations
indicators.measurement: Share of number of evaluations in NEP where a management response was formulated

indicators.name: Results information available to citizens
indicators.measurement: Total number of progress reports available online AND share of produced progress reports available online
indicators.note: Two measures are specified. The 75% historical target applies to the share, not to the count. Store numerator and denominator separately when data become available.

indicators.name: Citizens consulted on results
indicators.measurement: Share of ministries that have solicited feedback from citizens on performance and service delivery

index.score_rule: One point per Yes; maximum 12. Unanswered is unknown, not No. Do not issue a complete score when any response is missing.

questions.question: Has an M&E unit been established in the ministry?
Has the M&E unit been staffed, that is, is an M&E Officer in place in the ministry?
Does the ministry have an approved budget for M&E?
Has a strategic plan for the ministry been developed with a performance framework (indicators and targets)?
Does the strategic plan contain guidance on M&E or outline the required M&E arrangements in the ministry?
Is the ministry producing regular quarterly performance reports using the templates in annex 7?
Is the ministry holding quarterly performance review meetings, including agreeing on follow-up actions with assigned responsibilities and deadlines?
Did the ministry undertake any evaluations of its priority programmes or flagship projects during the last financial year?
Are the ministerial revenue and expenditure estimates informed by the ministerial KPIs and CMIs?
Are performance targets included in performance contracts and the ministerial service charter?
Are the performance reports disseminated, including the Ministerial Annual Progress Report, in electronic format on the ministerial website?
Are citizens consulted regularly on service delivery?
